source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 白衣女子初问笛声
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC08 after EP02 SC07 formal test-mode segment. Use this to plan the next 8-10 second short-drama shots through ComfyUI.
title: 仙音初问，少年失神

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC07 is approved only for pipeline validation. SH03 used a technical still fallback after Gemini provider 500 failures; production should regenerate the white-clothed woman reveal with a stable reference.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 白衣女子瞧见他不过是一个衣衫褴褛的少年，似乎也颇为诧异。淡然道：“方才的笛子是公子吹奏的吗？”
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 白衣女子放下玛瑙洞箫，清冷地询问方才的笛声是否出自拓拔野之手。拓拔野仍被她的气质震住，手中竹笛落地，耳中只剩自己的心跳。女子见他失神，轻声唤他；拓拔野终于回神，却笨拙地夸赞她的箫声如仙乐，试图强作镇定。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 随后白衣女子注意到拓拔野腰间的断剑无锋，询问此剑来历，剧情转入无锋剑与白龙鹿的线索。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, relic bundle, green bamboo flute falling from hand or on the ground, Wufeng in a bamboo sheath at the right waist.

White-clothed woman remains adult, elegant, distant, and water/rain-associated. Use the existing adult Yushiqie reference as the safest visual anchor, but frame her as a mysterious first-meeting figure.
Keep the emotional tone as awe, embarrassment, and mythic first encounter; avoid sexualized framing, body emphasis, or teen romance coding.
White dragon-deer remains alert and dignified near Tuobaye; avoid ordinary-deer drift where possible.
Setting remains moonlit Tianhu bamboo pavilion, lake reflection, bamboo shadows, mist, and faint incense smoke.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, speech bubbles, English words, signs, or plaques.
localization_rules: All planning text and eventual editing dialogue should be Chinese unless a technical field requires English.
Storyboard prompts may include the intended Chinese dialogue as off-screen planning context, but must request no rendered subtitles or readable text.
I2V prompts must use silent visual generation: no synthesized speech, no lip-sync dialogue, no flute/xiao audio, no captions, no subtitles, no readable signs, no English words.
Chinese dialogue, narration, xiao/flute sound design, heartbeat, and subtitles should be added later in editing.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: experimental_file_ids only while current local backend supports it; otherwise use official T2V smoke tests or switch provider for formal I2V
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Use stable reaction shots, subtle robe/hair/mist motion, hand lowering the xiao, flute falling or lying on the ground, and restrained facial reactions. Avoid lip-sync, fast body turns, or complex instrument-playing animation.

suggested_shots.title: 女子垂箫初问
suggested_shots.visual_focus: The adult white-clothed woman lowers the white agate xiao in moonlit bamboo and calmly addresses Tuobaye; her mouth should not visibly lip-sync.

suggested_shots.title: 竹笛坠地心跳如鼓
suggested_shots.visual_focus: Close reaction: Tuobaye's green bamboo flute drops or lies on the stone ground while his stunned face and heartbeat-like tension dominate the frame.

suggested_shots.title: 公子一唤回神
suggested_shots.visual_focus: The woman lightly frowns and calls to him; Tuobaye starts to recover from the trance while the white dragon-deer remains frozen beside him.

suggested_shots.title: 强作镇定赞仙乐
suggested_shots.visual_focus: Tuobaye awkwardly straightens his rough clothes and tries to stand confidently, silently praising the woman as an immortal musician in the later edit.
